what_changed:
Search: expanded Library search with advanced options in English.
• Search field expands when activated or while entering a query
• Search settings icon appears only after activating the search field; opens a collapsible options panel
• Filter by search scope (all assets, favorites, archive), people, date range, city, and media type (photos or videos)
• Choose how Immich interprets a query: Context, File name, Description, Full path or folder, or OCR
• Context queries use visual search; file details and OCR queries use metadata search
• Combine search interpretation with filters, or search with filters alone
• Reset filters returns to the Library timeline when the query is empty

Fixes and polish:
• Ignore outdated search responses when changing queries or filters
• Keep filtered results separate from the offline Library cache
• Validate date ranges and include the entire selected end date
• Match date inputs and the settings icon to the current theme
• Preserve normal copy/paste behavior inside search options
• Add accessible labels for search settings and filter controls
• Improve messages for filter-only searches and empty results

Appearance:
• Choose Lucide (default), Tabler, or Bootstrap Icons; selection is saved and applies immediately
• Preview the selected icon pack in Appearance settings
• Optional minimalist UI replaces navigation and action button labels with icons and compacts the sidebar
• Icon-only actions retain tooltips and accessible names; switching back restores button labels
• Icon packs include local SVG assets and license notices, so no downloads are needed at runtime

Search design:
• Restyle advanced search as a card with clearer filter labels, a date range row, and an active-filter counter
• Replace the interpretation dropdown with selectable Context, File name, Description, Full path or folder, and OCR buttons
• Show a short explanation for the selected search mode, with icon-only choices in minimalist UI
• Add subtle 180 ms expand/collapse and fade animations, plus a brief transition when switching search modes
• Keep rapid open/close interactions responsive and exclude collapsing controls from keyboard navigation
• Remove the rectangular button behind dropdown and calendar arrows; use a clean chevron matched to light and dark themes

Files and Folder Sync:
• Use the operating system's native file picker for upload, download, and folder selection
• Add multiple watched folders with the + button; browse, open, edit, and remove each folder independently
• Preserve existing single-folder settings and previously synced file history during migration
• Scan all configured folders and nested directories, deduplicating overlapping roots and keeping existing uploads queued when adding a folder
• Scroll long folder lists and persist sync history atomically
